title: Displacement in 2s
description: Essential: Correctly calculates displacement using free-fall kinematics (h = ½gt²) to obtain 20 m.

title: Work by gravity
description: Essential: Correctly calculates work done by gravity (W = mgh) using displacement from part (1) to obtain 100 J.

title: Momentum at ground
description: Essential: Correctly calculates final momentum (p = mv) after determining impact velocity (v = gt) to obtain 20 kg·m/s.

title: Kinematic reasoning
description: Important: Applies constant acceleration equations correctly for displacement and final velocity.

title: Work-energy connection
description: Important: Recognizes work done by gravity equals mg times displacement in direction of force.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units throughout calculations and presents answers with correct units.

title: Sign confusion
description: Pitfall: Uses wrong sign for displacement or velocity in work calculation (e.g., negative work for downward motion).

title: Time mix-up
description: Pitfall: Uses total fall time (4s) instead of specified interval (2s) for displacement or work calculations.
